_doc: Per-company adapter config for raw Refinitiv Eikon exports. Each entry describes one company's raw layout so the ingestion engine can normalize it without LLM/OCR. Adapter selection priority: by 'ticker' first, then 'isin'. If neither matches, falls back to the 'STANDARDIZED' adapter for any analyst-prepared template.

STANDARDIZED._doc: Default adapter for the analyst-validated standardized template (3 sheets: Altman Z + P&L CO + P&L Standalone)

SUN.NS._doc: Sun Pharmaceutical industries Ltd — uses the standardized template since analyst transcribes Refinitiv into it

DRREDDY.NS._doc: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories — example placeholder for a raw Refinitiv layout. Each sheet maps columns directly.
